issues: whether an employer's refusal to accommodate a disability without any investigation constitutes discrimination on the basis of disability
the scope and limits of the duty to accommodate, including the threshold of undue hardship
the procedural obligation to investigate and engage in the interactive process before refusing a requested accommodation
the standard of proof and allocation of onus in a disability discrimination claim
remedies available for failure to accommodate, including compensatory and punitive damages
key_facts: employee at a federally regulated bank
employee requested a modified schedule as accommodation
employer refused without investigating the request
causes_of_action: discrimination on the basis of disability
